globalRules: Fields may be used only as compact source-observed counter transition metadata.
Fields must not be renamed to deaths, kills, confirmed deaths, death events, final deaths, or match deaths.
Fields must not be joined with player identity, attribution, timeline, objective, spatial, macro, mechanics, fight, decision, or ML outputs.
Consumers must preserve finalFactsProduced=false and gameplayInterpretationProduced=false.

fields.allowedUse: Display count of compact Task 168 artifacts summarized.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as replay quality, match count beyond the summary scope, or factual gameplay evidence.

fields.allowedUse: Identify which compact artifact row is being referenced.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not infer player identity, match outcome, replay quality, or gameplay facts.

fields.allowedUse: Link to the compact death_validation artifact used as source metadata.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not imply the linked artifact contains event rows, attribution, or final facts.

fields.allowedUse: Display per-replay source-observed counter transition candidate count.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not call this deaths, kills, death events, confirmed deaths, player deaths, final deaths, or match deaths.

fields.allowedUse: Display compact duplicate transition-key count for source metadata quality.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as duplicated deaths, duplicated kills, or event-row deduplication.

fields.allowedUse: Display compact source validation status for each artifact.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as parser correctness proof, Source 2 semantic proof, or factual match truth status.

fields.allowedUse: Display aggregate count of source-observed counter transition candidates across the 15 compact artifacts.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not call this total deaths, total kills, final deaths, match deaths, confirmed deaths, or combat deaths.

fields.allowedUse: Display minimum per-replay source-observed counter transition candidate count in the summarized set.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as minimum deaths, minimum kills, or gameplay performance signal.

fields.allowedUse: Display maximum per-replay source-observed counter transition candidate count in the summarized set.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as maximum deaths, maximum kills, or gameplay performance signal.

fields.allowedUse: Display aggregate duplicate transition-key count across compact artifacts.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not treat as duplicated final facts or duplicated death events.

fields.allowedUse: Preserve the explicit meaning string next to any count display.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not omit or replace with deaths, kills, confirmed deaths, or final facts wording.

fields.allowedUse: Display or enforce that no final facts were produced.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not override to true or infer final facts from other fields.

fields.allowedUse: Display or enforce that no gameplay interpretation was produced.
fields.forbiddenUse: Do not override to true or infer gameplay interpretation from counts.
